ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white/light-gray pixels, with 30% low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central and edge regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity light regions dominate both fluke lobes. A broad, irregular low-intensity (black) region extends from the peduncle into the medial area of both lobes. Multiple discrete, small low-intensity circular blobs are mapped across the high-intensity fields, particularly on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 1/5th of the total visible vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary. The pixel-amplitude of peaks is notably more pronounced on the left lobe trailing edge compared to the smoother, though still serrated, right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips; the distal tips themselves are tapered and exhibit an upward-oriented curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of approximately 8-12 discrete, roughly circular low-intensity clusters (dark spots) against the light ventral background; highest density of these clusters is located in the middle and distal sections of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The distal tip of the left lobe shows a highly irregular, fragmented pixel boundary suggesting physical trauma; distinct irregular 'island' of black pigmentation located near the lower-right boundary of the left lobe.
